422.description: A value or reference rule failed (unknown location or appointment, invalid carrier, invalid unit number, seal class, hazmat class or UN number, unexplained destination, validation).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: Unknown location
value.detail: location is not an active slot of the site

value.title: The unit number is invalid
value.detail: invalid unit number: "CSQU3054380" has check digit 0; the expected check digit is 3

value.title: The hazmat class is invalid
value.detail: invalid hazmat class: "1.7" is not a US DOT hazard class (1 to 9) or division (such as 1.4, 2.1, 4.3, 6.1)

value.title: The UN number is invalid
value.detail: invalid UN number: "UN12" is not UN and four digits (for example UN1203)

value.title: The seal class is invalid
value.detail: invalid seal class: "X" is not one of I, S or H
